ambient.loop_hint: decode with Web Audio and loop the AudioBuffer; the seam is crossfaded. If buffer.duration is more than ~10 ms longer than duration_s (the decoder ignored the gapless header), set loopStart = mp3_gapless.priming_samples / sample_rate (seconds) and loopEnd = loopStart + duration_s.
